name: BleachBit
tagline: Clean cache, free disk space, and shred confidential files
description: BleachBit quickly frees disk space and guards your privacy. It cleans cache, deletes cookies, clears Internet history, shreds temporary files, deletes logs, and discards junk you did not know was there.
features: Deep system scanning to free gigabytes of unneeded files
Secure file shredding to prevent data recovery
Vacuum SQLite databases for Firefox and Thunderbird to boost speed
Command-line interface for automated cleanup scripts
requirements: Linux x86_64, root privileges optional for system-level cleaners
